chapter: Louis Armstrong and leaving New Orleans
title: Leaving New Orleans in 1919
summary: He left for health and returned deposits, saying he was losing his health.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: How long did you stay in New Orleans?
Well, let me see. What I went there. What was it, man? 1907.
1919 you left. Why did you leave?
Because I wanted to do better. I held back. It felt like I was going to lose my health down there. I spent the work. I'm doing all right.

I had close to $500 deposit on different jobs. I returned it all back to the promoters and told me, sorry. Well, you're an honest man. I told him I was losing my health. It's only like I could get out of contract. Which I was lying about.
